title: Watch Dashboard: Rich+Live to Textual Migration

stories.title: Assemble HeareDashboard App with bindings

Bind all hotkeys: s/x/r/m/M/t/p/q/left/right. set_interval timer calls _refresh_data which fetches DashboardSnapshot and distributes to widgets. Implement all action_* methods replacing _dispatch_key logic. action_text_input delegates to ControlsBar.show_input().

stories.title: Implement run_watch() with once mode
stories.description: Implement run_watch(settings, interval, once) in __init__.py. once=True: call fetch_dashboard_state(), render via rich.Console to stdout, exit with rc=0 (bypass App entirely). once=False: instantiate HeareDashboard, call app.run(). Remove old _make_key_reader/termios hack. Add legacy env-var routing (HEARE_WATCH_LEGACY=1 routes to _legacy.py).
acceptanceCriteria: run_watch() function defined in watch/__init__.py with signature (settings: Settings, interval: float, once: bool = False) -> int

once=True output is valid text (not ANSI escape sequences for full-screen app)
once=False branch: instantiates HeareDashboard(settings=settings, interval=interval), calls app.run()
Old _make_key_reader and termios hack code removed from run_watch()
HEARE_WATCH_LEGACY=1 env-var routes to _legacy.py run_watch (if _legacy.py exists)
